id: title:jonmcwest:run the volume rollup once per bucket not once per tick

review.posthog_relevance: Optimization of the volume tick workflow and rollup query performance, potentially reducing redundant database scans and improving latency monitoring.
review.reason: Adds a new function `teams_due_in_shard` and its unit tests, and refactors `_preview_due_bucket` to use it.
